scope: 216 development RGB inputs only: 192 continuous fish frames and 24 SUIM static images. No holdout inference, training or GLC encoding.
model_policy: Reuse the existing two target-specific SegFormer checkpoints as one fixed sender configuration; no model search. Fish and diver scores remain separate.

fish.inference: native 512 tiles, stride 384, mean overlapping logits then softmax

diver.inference: long edge 256, centered black letterbox, restored native logits, softmax

precision: FP32, no autocast or TF32, deterministic inference; original checkpoints unchanged
integrity_recheck: Skipped at user request; prior fingerprints are provenance only and are not reverified.
cache: Compare FP32 probabilities to all registered thresholds once; store exact binary memberships as PNG bits, not quantized probabilities. No GT is loaded by inference.

protection.seed: Union of fish and diver threshold masks; do not discard small connected components.
protection.margin: square dilation radius max(1, round(margin_at_1920 * max(width,height)/1920)); zero margin remains zero
protection.temporal: At most previous raw seed, without recursion or future frames; reset at each sequence and every static image. Hold may lag motion; evaluate it as a diagnostic, not guaranteed stability.
protection.soft_edge: After candidate selection, alpha=1 on hard protection, linear exterior feather width max(1,round(4*long_edge/1920)); keep the target core unchanged.
protection.fallback: Empty current union or hard protection >50% of frame disables background processing for that frame. Report fallback separately, never use its full-frame coverage to claim localization success.

evaluation.primary: Per-target raw precision/recall/IoU plus union protection coverage against independent GT; missing detections remain in all denominators.
evaluation.fish_instances: Use original COCO RLE, not boxes or connected components, with track identity. Area bins <0.1%, 0.1%-1%, >=1% of frame.
evaluation.instance_covered: At least 90% of labeled instance pixels protected; also report zero-overlap misses.
evaluation.diver: Per-image class1 coverage; SUIM connected components are not person instances. Eight-class base-model confusion is descriptive regression on the 24 selected images only.
evaluation.temporal: Consecutive-frame mask IoU/XOR, area change, per-track coverage changes and missing runs; motion and annotation changes confound flicker, so no causal flicker claim from XOR alone.
evaluation.background: GT complement may include unannotated targets. False-positive measures on SFISHTRACK are label-relative.
evaluation.selection: Among candidates passing all gates, choose smallest mean frame protection fraction; ties use listed order. If none pass, choose highest minimum of fish per-clip recall and diver mean image recall, then smallest area, listed order; freeze as diagnostic_only with explicit failed gates, not ready for general deployment.

runtime_reporting: Warm per-frame fish/diver inference wall time and full process time reported separately; no codec speed claims.
